title: Aevum Builder Challenge #1
description:
# Introduction

Aevum Builder Challenge #1 is a free, online hackathon for developers worldwide. Builders are challenged to ship practical stablecoin payment related applications on the Aevum testnet (the official testnet for QDay.io) using tUSD8. Participants deliver one end-to-end flow - including a smart contract, a simple interface or script, verified source code, and a short demo. Participants earn a fast track into the mainnet builder program ahead of QDay's mainnet launch in February.

# Timeline

- **16 Nov, 14:00 HKT (06:00 UTC)**: Registration opens; starter kit released.
- **16 Nov – 11 Dec**: Build period
- **11 Dec, 16:00 HKT (08:00 UTC)**: Submissions close
- **12 – 14 Dec**: Judging period.
- **15 Dec, 14:00 HKT (06:00 UTC)**: Demo Day: Top 5 finalist presentations and winner announcements.

# Prizes

A total prize pool of $1,500 paid in USDT:

- **1st Place**: $800 USDT
- **2nd Place**: $500 USDT
- **3rd Place**: $200 USDT

# Starter Guide

Please join our Discord Server and download your starter kit.
[https://discord.gg/bYPhjmrSfK](https://discord.gg/bYPhjmrSfK)

# How to submit

To successfully submit your project, teams must provide a comprehensive delivery package through the submission page. A standard submission requires the following components:

**1. Technical Deliverables**

- **Open Source Codebase:** A public **GitHub repository** link containing your clean, readable code.
- **Aevum Blockchain Integration:** Evidence that your application utilizes the QDay infrastructure (such as smart contracts, ERC-8004, QDay dapps).
- **Live Deployment:** A functional demo, prototype interface, or access to the packaged Docker image executing the application logic.

**2. Documentation & Presentation**

- **Video Pitch & Demo:** Top 5 projects will be invited to a **3 to 5-minute video call presentation** demonstrating the live, operational workflow of the application.
- **Project Documentation:** A brief overview explaining the problem your application solves, its system architecture, the core workflows, and a list of technologies used.

**3. No malicious code**

No malicious code and no attempts to attack the platform or other participants.

# Eligibility

- **Who Can Join**: Solidity and EVM developers, payment and fintech engineers, Web2 developers exploring Web3, and hackathon veterans.
- **Team Structure**: Solo developers or teams of 2 to 4 members formed prior to the event.
- **Build Constraints**: All code must be developed during the build window. All smart contracts must run on the Aevum testnet with test tokens only (no tokens are issued or promised).
- **Compliance**: Submission deadlines are firm, and prize distributions are subject to eligibility checks.

# Judging criteria

### 1. User experience and presentation

- **Intuitive interface and onboarding:** A clean, accessible, and responsive design (desktop/mobile) that enables first-time users to complete actions quickly with clear status feedback and plain-language error handling.
- **Compelling narrative and delivery:** A concise, confident pitch that clearly articulates the problem statement, user journey, and product value.

### 2. Demo clear and well-structured

- **Reliable end-to-end execution:** A well-paced, reproducible walkthrough showing the core flow, agent actions, and edge cases working reliably on testnet.
- **Verifiable on-chain activity:** Transparent proof of live execution, including visible transaction hashes, explorer links, and verifiable state changes.

### 3. Comprehensive documentation

- **Turnkey setup and architecture:** A clear README with architectural flowcharts, environment variable specifications, testnet addresses, and working step-by-step reproduction instructions.
- **Integration depth and specifications:** Detailed documentation explaining how each platform technology is integrated, complete with API examples, known constraints, and future roadmap items.

### 4. Innovation and originality

- **Fresh problem-solving:** A distinct, non-derivative approach that goes beyond standard templates, sample tracks, and existing hackathon submissions.
- **Creative agentic mechanics:** Novel implementations of autonomous agents, agentic payment primitives, or emerging on-chain business models.

### 5. Technical quality and platform integration

- **Idiomatic platform integration:** Deep, correct adoption of native platform tooling, including smart accounts, scoped session keys, spending limits, and identity primitives.
- **Resilience and code excellence:** Clean, well-structured, and tested code that robustly handles retries, asynchronous confirmations, edge cases, and smart contract security best practices.

### 6. Real-world utility and market potential

- **Workflow fit and user demand:** A practical solution targeting a well-defined audience with genuine demand, designed to slot smoothly into real merchant or automated agent operations.
- **Path to scale and monetization:** A viable business model supported by a sensible distribution plan and a realistic roadmap toward production and mainnet adoption.

### 7. Safety, trust and controls

- **Proactive risk parameters:** Strict adherence to least-privilege permissions, session expiration, and spend caps to guard against compromised keys, runaway spending, or prompt injection.
- **Auditability and user sovereignty:** Clear transaction review and approval steps, instant revocation mechanisms, full user data privacy, and verifiable on-chain audit trails.

### 8. Ecosystem contribution (reusable, open source)

- **Modular, open-source code:** Cleanly licensed, extensible codebases featuring reusable SDKs, component libraries, or scaffolding templates that other builders can easily adopt.
- **Community and developer value:** High potential to serve as an ecosystem infrastructure building block alongside actionable developer feedback, bug reports, and platform contributions.

# About Us

QDay is a post-quantum, EVM-compatible network built for the next generation of decentralized applications, autonomous agents, and programmable payments. QDay provides fast, low-cost infrastructure for applications that need frequent, programmable onchain transactions. It is EVM-compatible today and designed for sub-second settlement at mainnet, with SDKs, APIs and agent-ready payment capabilities — built for both human and machine-driven commerce.

tracks.name: Invoice Payments
tracks.description:
**Overview:** Build a business-to-business or merchant billing system powered by tUSD8 on the Aevum testnet.

**What to Build:** A solution where a merchant issues an invoice, the customer settles it in tUSD8 with an on-chain payment reference, and both parties can view the real-time settlement status and a receipt.

**Core Requirements:**Smart contract supporting invoice generation, reference tracking, and payment receipt logging.Simple user interface or script demonstrating the invoice creation and payment flow end-to-end.

tracks.name: Payroll and Vesting
tracks.description:
**Overview:** Build continuous or scheduled cash-flow infrastructure for Web3 organizations and traditional employers.

**What to Build:** Per-second or scheduled tUSD8 streaming contracts for salaries, team vesting, or ecosystem grants.

**Core Requirements:**Support for stream creation, real-time withdrawal, and stream cancellation.A working contract and interface/script proving tokens stream and settle accurately over time on the Aevum testnet.

tracks.name: Crowdfunding
tracks.description:
**Overview:** Create decentralized campaign funding mechanisms with automated accounting and milestone enforcement.

**What to Build:** A crowdfunding platform supporting funding targets, fixed deadlines, automatic refunds if the target is missed, and milestone-based fund releases if the goal is reached.

**Core Requirements:**Configurable funding targets and campaign expiry deadlines.Escrow mechanisms handling conditional logic: full refund release or milestone unlock disbursements in tUSD8.

tracks.name: Confirmation of Payee
tracks.description:
**Overview:** Implement safety verification mechanisms to eliminate misdirected payments and fraudulent transfers.

**What to Build:** A pre-flight verification system built on the ERC-8004 registry that resolves and displays the verified identity or name of a recipient before a transaction is submitted.

**Core Requirements:**Integration with the ERC-8004 registry.A clear sender workflow showing payee identity lookup, validation status, and final tUSD8 transfer execution.

tracks.name: Decentralized Payments
tracks.description:
**Overview:** Enable direct, non-custodial business payments and settlements in tUSD8 through smart contracts, removing reliance on centralized payment intermediaries.

**What to Build:** A non-custodial business payment application that allows organizations to send, receive, and settle tUSD8 directly on-chain, supporting advanced payment flows such as split distributions, marketplace payouts, and cross-border settlement.

**Core Requirements:** Direct smart contract integration for non-custodial tUSD8 settlements, supporting automated multi-party or split-payment routing alongside verifiable on-chain records for cross-border transactions.

tracks.name: Digital Ownership
tracks.description:
**Overview:** Link tUSD8 payment flows directly to the issuance and lifecycle management of digital assets, establishing verifiable proof of ownership on-chain.

**What to Build:** An application that automates the issuance, transfer, or renewal of digital assets—such as event tickets, software licenses, memberships, or access passes—triggered directly by tUSD8 payments.

**Core Requirements:** On-chain tUSD8 payment execution that programmatically handles asset issuance, renewal, and verifiable ownership verification alongside smart-contract-enforced rules for transfer, resale, or refunds.

tracks.name: Native AI Assistants
tracks.description:
**Overview:** Streamline corporate finance operations by deploying AI assistants that automate tUSD8 payment preparation, batch execution, and on-chain transaction reconciliation.

**What to Build:** An intelligent financial assistant that parses invoices or unstructured payment requests to stage single and batch tUSD8 transactions for user approval, coupled with an automated reconciliation engine that matches on-chain settlements against internal accounting records.

**Core Requirements:** Automated extraction of payment data across multiple file formats to prepare reviewable single or batch tUSD8 transactions, combined with intelligent on-chain reconciliation that flags discrepancies in plain language and generates accounting-ready exports.

tracks.name: Open Innovation
tracks.description:
**Overview:** Build any viable, high-utility business payment tool on Aevum that addresses real-world commerce needs.

**What to Build:** Any production-ready payment application, including commercial escrow, recurring subscription billing, corporate expense approval workflows, point-of-sale checkout systems, or micro-billing infrastructure.

**Core Requirements:**Clear demonstration of an end-to-end transaction flow using tUSD8.Verifiable smart contracts deployed to the Aevum testnet.
